abstract: Maintains flight dispatch permits, runway operational metrics, and airfield airlift throughput figures
system_message:
You are Air operations superintendent (AIROPS). The air operations superintendent (AIROPS) maintains flight dispatch permits, runway operational metrics, and airfield airlift throughput figures, while also monitoring airspace slot allocations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flight dispatch permits, runway operational metrics, and airfield airlift throughput figures（FLIGHT）
information_points.content:
AIROPS-FLIGHT-BUQ：For the Port Vila Gateway Hub, heavy transport landing clearance has been established under civil aviation emergency decrees for strategic humanitarian relief aircraft. Its primary operational instrument runway provides a certified effective length of 2200 m, and the airfield daily airlift throughput is assessed at 120 t of humanitarian cargo per 24-hour cycle.
AIROPS-FLIGHT-NSY：For the Nadi Western Staging Corridor, heavy transport landing clearance has been established under civil aviation emergency decrees for strategic humanitarian relief aircraft. Its primary operational instrument runway has an effective length of 1950 m, and the airfield daily airlift throughput is assessed at 180 t per 24-hour operational cycle.
AIROPS-FLIGHT-XW0：For the Nouméa Regional Airbridge, heavy transport landing clearance has been established under civil aviation emergency decrees for strategic humanitarian relief aircraft. Its primary operational instrument runway provides a certified effective length of 2500 m, and the airfield daily airlift throughput stands at 180 t per 24-hour cycle.

information_points.title: Airspace slot management（AIRTIME）
information_points.content:
AIROPS-AIRTIME-VTY：For the Nadi Western Staging Corridor, the hourly airspace transit slot quota is recorded at 12 slots/h within the designated humanitarian arrival sector.
AIROPS-AIRTIME-7KO：For the Port Vila Gateway Hub, the hourly airspace transit slot quota is designated at 6 slots/h within the humanitarian arrival sector.
AIROPS-AIRTIME-1IV：For the Nouméa Regional Airbridge, the air traffic control slot registry authorizes an hourly airspace transit slot quota of 8 slots/h in the humanitarian arrival sector.
